concept: Knowledge graph embedding, structure or text
area: Area 1: architectures that combine graphs and embeddings
current_formulation: A language model scores a triple from the text of its entity and relation descriptions instead of from structure alone.

steps.formulation: TransE: a relation is a translation between entity vectors learned from triples alone.
steps.quote: models relationships by interpreting them as translations operating on the low-dimensional embeddings of the entities

criticism.quote: We note that TransE does not do well in dealing with these properties.

steps.formulation: TransH: a relation is a translation on a relation-specific hyperplane.
steps.quote: models a relation as a hyperplane together with a translation operation on it

criticism.quote: none of existing models is capable of modeling and inferring all the above patterns

steps.formulation: RotatE: a relation is a rotation in complex vector space.
steps.quote: the RotatE model defines each relation as a rotation from the source entity to the target entity in the complex vector space

criticism.quote: most knowledge graph embedding models only use structure information in observed triple facts, which suffer from the sparseness of knowledge graphs

steps.formulation: KG-BERT: triples are treated as text sequences and scored by a language model over entity and relation descriptions.
steps.quote: We treat triples in knowledge graphs as textual sequences

criticism.quote: a major limitation is that BERT model is expensive
